phrase: An AI company preparing to go public devoted over a hundred pages of its filing to warning investors about catastrophic risk to humanity. The IPO is moving forward anyway.
phraseAlternatives: The company behind one of the best-known chatbots just filed to go public. More than a quarter of the document explains how its own product could end badly for everyone.
An AI lab preparing for the stock market quietly admitted it is burning more natural gas to keep its growth plans running. Its prospectus still calls the risk catastrophic.
A company warns, in writing, that its own technology could pose a catastrophic risk to humanity. It is asking investors for billions anyway.
alt: A blueprint-style building stands on a stock-exchange podium holding a document marked CATASTROPHIC RISK against its side, two small investors below reach up with money, and a separate rising stock chart in the upper left has a tiny yellow flag stuck through its arrow tip.

brief.composition: Center the institution-building figure stepping onto the podium, the stamped document held at chest height so CATASTROPHIC RISK reads clearly.
